spec.userPrompt:

Choices:
A. [MARKED CORRECT] avait lu
B. lisait
C. a lu
D. lira

responses.raw:

REASON: The phrase "Si seulement" (If only) expresses a wish or regret about the past, and when referring to an event that didn't happen before another past event (indicated by "hier"), the plus-que-parfait "avait lu" is the correct tense to convey this regret that she had not read her letter before answering yesterday.
